decisive_items: superficial and deep perivascular and interstitial inflammation with numerous eosinophils
started as an erythematous papule on her right arm 2 months after initiation of a new immunotherapy regimen
Erythematous annular plaques without scale on her right arm and bilateral legs
response.rationale: R3 uniquely integrates the drug exposure (immunotherapy) with the eosinophilic histopathology, matching the clinical and biopsy findings. R1 is a broader irAE label but lacks the eosinophilic specificity.

rejected.why: Only attributes to pembrolizumab, but patient also received ipilimumab; less specific than R3.
Only attributes to ipilimumab, ignoring pembrolizumab and eosinophilic pattern.
Descriptive term only, not a diagnosis and lacks etiologic or histologic specificity.
Captures eosinophilic dermatitis but omits the drug-induced context.
Eosinophilic cellulitis typically presents with painful edematous plaques, not annular asymptomatic lesions; histology also lacks flame figures.
